title: Anger at someone’s very presence
literal_meaning: Not crossing even where that person’s shadow falls.
explanation: The source explains this as intense anger towards someone. Avoiding even their shadow exaggerates how complete that rejection feels.
meaning_odia: କାହା ଉପରେ ଏତେ ରାଗ ଯେ ତାଙ୍କ ପାଖକୁ ବି ଯିବାକୁ ମନ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ—ସେହି ଭାବ ଏଠାରେ ଦିଶେ।
usage_example: After an argument, someone refuses even to sit nearby. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: An emotional exaggeration, not a claim about shadows.
